card.name: Linking words before trastuzumab-type drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (and, plus, with, of, a colon, an open parenthesis) right before a HER2 cancer drug name such as trastuzumab, in breast cancer drug labels.

modes.label: Joining a drug pair
modes.description: A word like and, plus or with links one HER2 drug to another named combination partner.
modes.example: before starting PERJETA<< and>> trastuzumab or trast

modes.label: Punctuation before a drug
modes.description: A colon or open parenthesis precedes a HER2 drug name or a regimen.
modes.example: HER2-Positive First-line Metastatic Breast Cancer<<:>> ENHERTU 5.4 mg

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before the next HER2 breast cancer drug name in a label.
